verdict.rationale: Docs strongly market LlamaParse as an agentic, layout-aware parser producing 'clean markdown, text, or JSON' from complex documents (docs-2, docs-12, docs-25) with markdown expansion options (docs-11), and early community feedback praised its handling of complex layouts versus open-source parsers (comm-1, comm-2). However, no evidence specifically addresses stripping of repeated headers/page furniture, and some hands-on community feedback flags real output-quality gaps (tables not returned in tabular form, disputed benchmark numbers) that temper the 'clean for LLM consumption' claim (comm-3, comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of header/footer/page-furniture deduplication, and independent verification of noise-free markdown output.
